Name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
Description: Owner: Marcus (fix), Sam (verification). Fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback that occurs when a user backgrounds the app mid-upload on Android 14. Repro: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. It is the top crasher, affecting about 4% of Android sessions. Deadline: fixed and verified by Wednesday (August 12) so QA has time before the August 20 release. Sam to confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices and add it to the regression run.

Name: Build backend sync API for offline notes mode
Description: Owner: Elena. Build a sync API endpoint this sprint: the client sends its last-synced timestamp and gets a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for now; no merge UI in this pass. Deadline: have the sync API in review before Elena is out on the 17th and 18th.

Name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
Description: Owner: Marcus. Implement the client side of offline mode for the notes list: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay them when connectivity comes back. Acceptance criteria: you can open the app in airplane mode, see your notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when you're back online with no data loss. Write the acceptance criteria into the ticket.

Name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
Description: Owner: Sam. Finish the test and release pipelines for GitHub Actions, keep the nightly build schedule, and run both Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off. Keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean. Approved by Priya.

Name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
Description: Owner: Elena. Add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint to prevent degradation from misbehaving scripts. Requirements: 100 requests per minute per user; return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that limit; include a metrics counter so we can see who's hitting the limit.

Name: Update consent screen for GDPR compliance
Description: Owner: Marcus. Update the privacy policy/consent screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. Get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen. Nothing should be pre-checked. This is a launch blocker and must be in the August 20 release.

Name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
Description: Owner: Sam. Write regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal: have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
